card.name: Words before metric conversions in parentheses
card.fires_on: Words and numbers just before or inside a parenthesized metric conversion, such as (5-kilometer) or (28,000-square-kilometer), in general web text. It also fires on scattered other words in encyclopedic or scripture text.

modes.label: Inside metric conversions
modes.description: Numbers or hyphenated units within a bracketed metric equivalent of an imperial measure.

modes.label: Quantity words and numbers
modes.description: Numbers or scale words in measurements, dates, or amounts.

modes.label: Scattered other words
modes.description: Isolated words or punctuation in news, history or scripture passages with no shared link.
modes.example: was named<< for>> former Governor Benjamin Grubbs Humphre

card.writes: It promotes abbreviation-like tokens such as Eq and msg and suppresses Maximum and configuration tokens, so there is no clear unified effect.
